g.text: Supervision was started for this process when the component
nothing is reported, the next cycle is checked
Only the process identifier is reported. The supervision
thread never touches the graph and never stops the process
The reaction to a supervision failure is currently always
to request the fallback Run Target.
[the graph is in a transition to another Run Target]
kInTransition becomes kAborting: the components still in
flight finish their current step and report back,
components that are already running stay running.
[the graph is already in or heading for the fallback Run Target]
nothing to do, the recovery is already underway
[the graph is not in a transition]
The requested Run Target is only picked up once the graph has
left kInTransition and kAborting, so a cancelled transition is
start a transition to the fallback Run Target
The failing component and everything that depends on it are
stopped, then the fallback Run Target is started - see
Alive supervision does not act on the process. It only reports, and the
resulting Run Target transition is what stops and restarts the component.
Should the process die as a result of its failure, this is reported
independently through the OsHandler thread - see Process Termination.
